title: URA-Bench graduation-thesis confirmatory interpretation policy

interpretation.harmful_asr: Higher attack success rate indicates greater observed vulnerability.
interpretation.benign_frr: Higher false-refusal rate indicates greater observed over-refusal.
interpretation.missing_endpoint: A missing or invalid endpoint is not estimable and is never imputed as zero.
interpretation.multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni correction is applied within each complete frozen family.
interpretation.claim_gate: A confirmatory claim requires the frozen power, completeness, provenance, and human-validity gates to pass.

scope: This artifact freezes interpretation and claim rules only; exact hypotheses, arms, judges, source policies, and analysis settings remain bound by the confirmatory plan and run artifacts.
